faqs.question: How do I scale a recipe?
faqs.answer: Input the original serving size and your desired serving size to get precise ingredient amounts.

faqs.question: Can this work for any recipe?
faqs.answer: Yes, it works for most recipes, making adjustments for any ingredient.

faqs.question: What if I want to adjust only one ingredient?
faqs.answer: You can adjust individual ingredients by entering their original amounts and desired servings.
